chung.Syllabus Name: Consumer behavior in Tourism_Hành vi khách du lịch
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
-Objective: The subject is aimed at providing a vital understanding of contemporary tourist behaviour and its application in a variety of sectors of tourism.

-Description: Students will acquire broad knowledge of consumer behavior in tourism and hospitality industry. They will be able to describe and explain tourist behaviors through the perspectives of human psychology.They can also determine the role of tourist behaviors in the process of tourism product development, quality management and other marketing decisions.

-Teaching Method:

Basic input will be given by the lecturer in order to initiate discussions on the relevant topics. Therefore, students are required to prepare the reading material in advance. In class, short group works will take place. This should further stimulate discussion between students and allow them to immediately apply theoretical knowledge to mini-case studies. Additionally, discussion should allow students to reflect on observations of own or (other) tourists’ behaviour and identify linkages with management and marketing of tourism (products).

clo: To explain the concept and models of consumer behavior in tourism and hospitality industry
To get insight into the how today’s consumers select, purchase, use and experience the tourism and hospitality products.
To identify different market segments and analyse the consumer behavior in different market and across the sectors in tourism and hospitality industry
To update with the development trend and controversial issues of tourism behaviour internationally and in Vietnam
To practice the professional attitude and skills of achieving understanding of consumer behavior before any decision in business decisions
To apply the understanding of the consumer behavior into product development, quality management and other marketing decisions in tourism

Case study analysis and questions given with the case

Students will work in group of 4-5 students and will be scheduled to be in charge of one case study given in the coursebook (allocated by instructors) which is related to the topics learnt in the earlier weeks. They have to analyse the case study by answering the questions given with the case.

Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.
LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6
Tourism market to Vietnam: profile development and analysis

Students will work in group of 4-5 students and will be given a tourism market to be in charge of. They are required to develop a detailed profile of the market and to analyse the consumer behavior of the market. Basing on the profile and analysis, suggestions for product development, marketing activities and quality management should be made.
